She has one foot resting on a small step stool next to a white toilet. (2) The toddler turns away from the toilet and walks across the tiled floor toward a light-colored wooden storage rack that holds beige fabric bins. She reaches down with her hands and pulls out the bottom fabric bin, looking into it with curiosity as it slides out. (3) There is a quick visual cut to the girl standing at a white bathroom sink. A woman's arm is visible as she holds a blue toothbrush, assisting the toddler in brushing her teeth while they both look toward the mirror. (4) The scene shifts back to the floor area where the toddler is now sitting inside the beige fabric storage bin. She moves her legs and adjusts her seating position while looking at the camera and the surroundings of the bathroom floor. (5) The video concludes with a static pink background featuring a small cartoon illustration of a girl in the center and white text logo positioned below it.
